sections.content: Expressions such as es importante que, es mejor que and me parece fundamental que trigger the subjunctive when they express an evaluation about another action or situation.

items.spanish: Es importante que tengamos tiempo para nosotros.
items.english: It is important that we have time for ourselves.

items.spanish: Me parece fundamental que una persona encuentre satisfacción en su trabajo.
items.english: It seems fundamental to me that a person finds fulfilment in their work.

items.spanish: Es mejor que busques un equilibrio.
items.english: It is better for you to look for a balance.

sections.content: Use the subjunctive after an evaluation expression when the following clause has its own subject.
